post.title: Which country has the most wild TIGERS? 🐅
post.description:
Which country has the most wild TIGERS? Guess first — then watch the map fly to the answer: 3,682 wild tigers in 2022, more than the rest of the world combined, and how the count more than doubled since 2006.

What was your first guess? Do share in the comments below.

Sources: Press Information Bureau (All India Tiger Estimation 2022), Wikipedia (Tiger reserves of India, Siberian tiger, Jim Corbett National Park), Hindustan Times, Times of India.
Map data: Natural Earth (public domain) · imagery NASA Blue Marble. Voice: AI (Kokoro).
